headline: Adds drag-and-drop section reordering in BetterBags Next column layouts and separates section sort settings by design.

entries.title: Drag to reorder sections in column layouts
entries.details: You can now drag section headers to reorder them directly within multi-column layouts in BetterBags Next. Dragging preserves a section's shape while held and prevents the layout from shifting or jittering under the cursor.

entries.title: Independent section sorting per design
entries.details: Section sort order is now saved separately for each bag layout design. BetterBags Next defaults to sorting by size descending, while classic bags return to alphabetical sorting.
